ns2:course.label: Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: Individual research for majors in Media and Cinema Studies leading to the completion of a thesis. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing, a declared Media and Cinema Studies Major, and consent of advisor.
